name: Ganaha You
source:
A mysterious woman who got lost while searching for Kawakami, the city of martial arts, and ended up in Shonan. She has a strange appearance, with a muscular, tall figure of 222cm, huge breasts, spiked piercings, brown skin and silver hair, and a scarf covering her mouth, and her martial arts skills are no mean feat.
Since coming to Shonan, she has been taking out delinquents in outdoor matches under the name "Speed ​​Kingdom".
She is acquainted with Azusa and knows her true abilities.
